modes.title: Choose how to read
modes.body: Switch between transliteration, translation and Arabic here. Your choice stays for the next surahs too.

jump.title: Go to a verse
jump.body: Type a verse number and the page scrolls straight to it. In long surahs you find what you want in seconds.

karaoke.title: The words read along with you
karaoke.body: The word being recited glows gold; the ones already read stay lit. Follow along — it helps most with memorising and pronunciation.

listen.title: Give Listen a tap
listen.body: The surah starts from the beginning and each word lights up as it is recited. The first 60 seconds are free — try it whenever you like.
listen.bodyPremium: The surah starts from the beginning and each word lights up as it is recited. Follow along as you read.
